Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1975
ACT IV OF 1975
PAKISTAN CRIMINAL
LAW (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment
Act, 1958
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th January 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 13th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Pakistan Criminal Law
(Amendment) Act, 1974.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

General Amendment, Act XL of 1958

PAKISTAN CRIMINAL
LAW (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974
An Act further to
amend the Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment
Act, 1958
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th January 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 13th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :--
2. General Amendment, Act XL
of 1958.------In the Pakistan Criminal Law Amendment Act, 1958 (XL of
1958), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for the words "Central
Government", wherever occurring, the words "Federal Government"
shall be substituted.

Amendment of section 3, Act XL of 1958

3. Amendment of section 3, Act
XL of 1958.---In the said Act, in section 3, in subsection (2), for clause
(a) the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(a) is, or is qualified to
be, a Judge of a High Court ; or".
